caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a person with arms crossed at the front. The individual is wearing a black hat with a brown band and a brownish-red jacket. A red scarf or neckerchief is tied around the neck. The person's skin tone is a muted brownish color, and they have brown hair visible beneath the hat. The face is turned to the right (from the viewer’s perspective), with an open mouth and bared teeth showing. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery visible, creating a strong contrast with the detailed figure centrally positioned in the composition.
title: Tavern Bust
